gloss_en: IfcCSV only exports attributes; how do I dump attributes, property sets and materials of an IFC to Excel?
title_original: IFCのAttribute、PropertySet、Materialを一式書き出す
question_paraphrase: IfcOpenShellのIfcCSVだとAttributeしか書き出せないので、PropertySetとMaterialも一緒にExcelへ出したい
phrasing_notes: Terse blog style, assumes knowledge of IFC entity names, code first, minimal prose, emoji marker in title
answer_summary: Walk IfcProject via IsDecomposedBy/ContainsElements, read get_info(), IfcRelDefinesByProperties and IfcRelAssociatesMaterial, write three sheets (Attribute, Property, Material) with a Level column; only IfcPropertySingleValue handled.

gloss_en: How to get the storey names and elevations from an IFC with IfcOpenShell
title_original: IfcOpenShellで階情報を取得する
question_paraphrase: IFCファイルから階の名前と高さ(Elevation)をIfcOpenShellで取り出したい
phrasing_notes: Beginner-friendly memo, shows TypeError from str+float concatenation, 'IFCBUILDINGSTOREY' uppercase entity name
answer_summary: ifc.by_type('IFCBUILDINGSTOREY'), read .Name and .Elevation by attribute name instead of positional index; use str() or f-string; check units.

gloss_en: What power does IDS give for operating IFC correctly (clients checking contractor IFC automatically)?
title_original: IFCデータを正しく運用する為のIDSの威力とは？
question_paraphrase: 発注者の要求がExcelやPDFでバラバラで、納品IFCのチェックが人力。IDSで機械的に検証できる？
context_given: 建築基準法/耐火性能の例
phrasing_notes: Explanatory essay, uses 野良データ (stray data) metaphor, ties to ISO 19650 EIR and LOIN
answer_summary: IDS XML = applicability + requirements with six facets (Entity, Attribute, Classification, Property, Material, PartOf); geometry/clash checks out of scope; needs IFC expertise and agreed data rules.

gloss_en: Explainer for architects: using Revit-MCP so AI can create/modify Revit elements in natural language
title_original: 意匠設計者のためのRevit-MCP解説：AIとRevitの連携で設計業務を効率化
question_paraphrase: AIに『3〜10階に同じ部屋割りを作って』『窓幅を一括変更』『20m2未満の部屋を赤に』と頼めるか
phrasing_notes: Designer-oriented explainer, example commands in natural language, lists limits plainly
answer_summary: MCP server + Revit plugin via external events; AI-written C# fails on complex cases; 10 s command timeout, 2 min websocket timeout.

gloss_en: Intro to openBIM/IFC/BCF/IDS/LOD for IT people using software analogies
title_original: 情報系のためのopenBIM入門
question_paraphrase: IT出身者向けに、IFCはUSB Type-C、BCFはGitHub Issues、IDSはlinterのようなものと説明
phrasing_notes: Developer analogies, casual tone, mixes English acronyms freely
answer_summary: BIM = CAD plus database; IFC avoids vendor lock-in; BCF shares issues without whole models; IDS validates attributes; LOD should match phase.

gloss_en: Interpretation of FlangeSlope in IfcIShapeProfileDef: sign and reference position are unspecified
title_original: IFCのProfileDefのSlopeの解釈が知りたい
question_paraphrase: IfcIShapeProfileDefのFlangeSlopeは正の値でどっち向き？基準位置はフランジのどこ？公式は説明が少ない
phrasing_notes: Scrap (memo thread) style, wants to understand, compares viewers, cites DeepResearch
answer_summary: Spec silent; practical reading: positive = thicker at root; reference position varies by profile type; IShape unknown.

gloss_en: Running buildingSMART IFC Validation Service locally in Docker: workers restart, uploads never process
title_original: IFC Validation Service をローカルで動かす
question_paraphrase: 公式手順どおりmake startしたらhttp://localhostがエラー、backendとworkerが再起動を繰り返す
phrasing_notes: Step-by-step troubleshooting log, quotes error messages
answer_summary: Align git submodule to the tagged commit; create and activate the Django SYSTEM user; restart worker.

gloss_en: Wants to understand where geometry, attributes and relations live in IFC and how entities link
title_original: IFCのデータの紐づけ構造を理解したい
question_paraphrase: IFCを可視化できたが形状や属性がどこにどんな形式で入っているのか分からない
phrasing_notes: Self-study notes, honest about incomplete understanding
answer_summary: Relations via IfcRelAggregates, IfcRelDefinesByProperties, IfcRelAssociates, IfcRelDefinesByType; placement chain via PlacementRelTo; IfcMappedItem reuse; get_decomposition may duplicate.

gloss_en: Convert IFC to glTF keeping the spatial hierarchy; IfcOpenShell slow, web-ifc fast but glTF export unsolved
title_original: IFCをglTFに変換する
question_paraphrase: IFCをglTFにして階層構造(Project>Site>Building>階>要素)も残したい。IfcOpenShellは遅い
phrasing_notes: Working notes with timings, candid dissatisfaction
answer_summary: Own converter with geom + pygltflib; web-ifc ~30x faster (30s to 1s) but fell back to PLY.

gloss_en: Letting Claude Code build Revit add-ins autonomously; MCP found a poor fit versus running C# in the live model
title_original: Claude CodeでRevitアドインを自律的に開発できるようにした話
question_paraphrase: Revitのエラーはダイアログに隠れてエージェントが結果を見られない。DLLロックやPDB無しで行番号が出ない
phrasing_notes: Engineer postmortem style, enumerated problems
answer_summary: Bridge ('BIM Agent Relay') runs C# in the live model, loads DLL from byte array, loads PDB; fixed MCP toolset cannot cover the Revit API.

gloss_en: Opening huge IFC with IfcOpenShell is slow and memory-hungry; lazy loading in 0.9.0
title_original: IfcOpenShell の遅延読み込み
question_paraphrase: 大きいIFCを開くと全インスタンス・属性を先にパースして遅くメモリを食う
phrasing_notes: Numeric benchmark article
answer_summary: Lazy mode scans IDs/types/GlobalId only, parses on access; 392MB: 11.3s to 1.4s, ~3GB to ~1GB.

gloss_en: Comparing 13 web-ifc versions on the same IFC: unsupported IFC4.3 in old versions, geometry count changes, StreamMeshes BindingError in 0.0.78
title_original: web-ifc 13 バージョンを同じ IFC で比べた検証ログ（0.0.50〜0.0.78）
question_paraphrase: web-ifcを上げる前に何が変わるか。0.0.50はIFC4X3_ADD2でUnsupported Schema、0.0.78のブラウザ版StreamMeshesでBindingError
phrasing_notes: Verification log, medians, caveats about margin of error
answer_summary: 0.0.53+ reads IFC4.3; geometry count no longer equals element count from 0.0.75; workaround calls wasmModule.StreamMeshes directly until upstream fix (issue 2219).

gloss_en: Site staff cannot open IFC without multi-GB software; built a browser-only IFC viewer with clash check
title_original: WebAssembly × Three.js でブラウザ完結の無料 IFC ビューアを作った話
question_paraphrase: IFCを少し見るだけで数GBのソフトが必要。現場担当は開く環境がなく設計変更のたび重いアプリを起動
phrasing_notes: Motivation as complaint about heavy tools, privacy angle (no upload)
answer_summary: web-ifc WASM parsing in browser, Octree raycast, AABB then BVH clash, chunked mesh building to avoid UI freeze.

gloss_en: Extract values from heavy Revit models from subcontractors without opening them; ETL to columnar store
title_original: BIMデータをETLしよう - OLAP向けにEAVで正規化して列指向に保存する理由
question_paraphrase: 協力会社の重いモデルや古いモデルを開かずに値だけ取り出したい。API/プラグイン経由は遅くAPSは組織整備が前提
phrasing_notes: Data-engineer voice, pain-point list
answer_summary: EAV + column-oriented storage in Parquet, analyze with DuckDB.

gloss_en: After IFC export about half the elements were missing
title_original: IFCに出したら、半分なかった。3Dの箱と、壁ツールの壁は別物です
question_paraphrase: IFCに書き出したらモデルの半分が消えていた。ただのソリッド、階に紐づかないレイヤ、非表示要素が原因
phrasing_notes: First-person architect, hedges claims about Revit/Archicad from help pages, clean analogies (clay vs parts)
answer_summary: Assign IFC entity/classification to objects, link layers to stories, check visibility options, re-open the IFC to verify.

gloss_en: BIM drawing review (Apr 2026) vs BIM data review (spring 2029): what is submitted and how IFC is used
title_original: 確認申請の「図面の突き合わせ」が変わった｜2026年4月のBIM図面審査と、2029年春のBIMデータ審査
question_paraphrase: BIM図面審査では確認申請書+BIM書き出しPDF+同時書き出しIFC+誓約書を提出。IFCは審査対象外。AIはどこまで入る？
phrasing_notes: Explanatory news-analysis, polite desu/masu, enumerates deliverables
answer_summary: Currently IFC is reference only; 2029 view review/digital review with IFC; fully automated review excluded for accountability.

gloss_en: MLIT 2029 BIM data review: view review vs digital review, initial ~10 review items
title_original: BIMデータがそのまま審査対象に。2029年春スタートの新制度を整理してみた
question_paraphrase: 国交省の基本構想では採光・換気、容積率、建蔽率、斜線など約10項目から。構造・省エネは検討中
phrasing_notes: News-digest note, cites secondary source, structured bullets
answer_summary: Phased rollout; PDF kept for items IFC cannot express; verify against MLIT pages.

gloss_en: IFC is not omnipotent: editing, live links and classifications are lost; creating IFC is not the same as delivering information
title_original: BIMを解く #09―IFCは万能なのか
question_paraphrase: Rhinoで作ったモデルをIFCに出して確認申請用BIMや引き渡しに使えるのか。見た目は合っていても分類や属性が使えない
phrasing_notes: Reflective essay, states 'IFCは万能ではありません'
answer_summary: Define purpose first, then decide what goes into IFC vs native data.

gloss_en: Prepare for 2029 data review by exporting one room to IFC and re-reading it in another viewer
title_original: 2029年のBIMデータ審査に備えるなら、まず一室を「書き出して読む」
question_paraphrase: 部屋名・用途・床面積がIFCに出て別ビューアで読めるか。面積が合わない時は境界・計算方法・単位・版を確認
phrasing_notes: Practical checklist, 3-group result log
answer_summary: Export with normal settings, open in different viewer, check mapping, use, area and unit; isolate cause between model, export settings, viewer.

gloss_en: Can the free Rust BIM app BIMCraft handle the 2029 review IFC? Reads IFC2x3/IFC4, writes IFC4
title_original: 建築BIM：国交省の2029年春審査、BIMCraftは使えるか
question_paraphrase: 個人開発のBIMCraft(MCP/CLI操作可)は審査用IFCに使えるか。RVTは読み取りのみ、カーテンウォールや階段は未対応
phrasing_notes: Evaluation with caveats about self-reported claims
answer_summary: Treat as low-cost IFC/AI test tool, not production; verify the official repository.

gloss_en: Why expectations of IFC drift from reality: sharing not exchange; loss of parametrics; IFC2x3/4/4.3 coexist
title_original: IFCとは何か？BIM実務で「期待がズレやすい理由」と正しい使い方
question_paraphrase: IFCにすれば別ソフトで編集を続けられると思われがち。実際はパラメトリック関係や独自パラメータが落ちる
phrasing_notes: Numbered pitfalls, warns against 'IFCにすれば解決' illusion
answer_summary: Native for authoring, IFC for share/check; agree version and export conditions; verify in receiving software before delivery.

gloss_en: BIM利用技術者 exams: practical tasks include submitting IFC with drawings; IFC2x3 from FY2026
title_original: BIM利用技術者とは？｜「未来の建築確認に直結する資格」になる？
question_paraphrase: 準一級・一級の実技で、審査フローに沿ってモデル作成、図面抽出、面積算定、IFCと図面の提出
phrasing_notes: Career-oriented explainer with roadmap
answer_summary: Levels 2 then Semi-1 then 1; own PC and IFC export setup; author's view on link to BIM review.

gloss_en: Is open-source Bonsai usable for Japanese practice? Walls on face not 壁芯, hatches, sliding-door presets
title_original: オープンソースBIM Bonsai(Blender BIM)は実務に使えるか？
question_paraphrase: 年42万〜138万円の商用BIMに対し無料で。壁が芯でなく面基準、ハッチング、1間引き違い戸が作れない
phrasing_notes: Trial diary, Japanese drafting vocabulary (壁芯, 1間)
answer_summary: Early-stage; offsets and 2D output need customization; Japanese Bonsai info scarce.

gloss_en: BIM-based quantity takeoff: reading IFC from ArchiCAD for estimating; unmodeled members need rules
title_original: BIMを活用した積算業務 ── 数量算出の仕組みから導入の勘所まで
question_paraphrase: 図面から数量を拾うのが時間と精度の両立が難しい。モデル化されない部材の数量ルールは？
phrasing_notes: Business explainer, partly paywalled
answer_summary: MLIT encourages IFC for takeoff; Maeda reads ArchiCAD IFC for exterior walls, columns, beams into estimating software.

gloss_en: Small MEP office on Jw_cad: how to prepare for BIM cheaply, view architect IFC for free
title_original: 小さな設備設計事務所のためのBIM入門
question_paraphrase: Jw_cadで2D図面。元請から意匠IFCを受けて設備ルートを3D確認したい。ソフトを買う根拠がない
phrasing_notes: Anxious-pragmatic, stepwise plan, mentions 建築GX・DX推進事業 subsidy
answer_summary: Learn, view IFC free, trial on small area, buy later; verify round-trip conversion before delivery.

gloss_en: openBIM workflow centered on bSDD with IFC, IDS, BCF, openCDE
title_original: openBIM ワークフローについて
question_paraphrase: 全てのopenBIMはbSDDから始まる、というワークフロー整理
phrasing_notes: Vendor-leaning explainer, little concrete detail
answer_summary: No concrete exchange problems; points to prior articles on bSDD and IDS.

gloss_en: Create floors, walls, a door and a window from scratch with IfcOpenShell: units, placement, containment, opening order
title_original: ゼロから始めるPythonとIfcOpenShellでのBIM/3D建築モデル作成入門 建築編
question_paraphrase: assign_containerを忘れると床が表示されない。開口を作ってからドア窓をadd_filling
phrasing_notes: Tutorial with copy-paste naming inconsistencies
answer_summary: Set units, relative placements, assign_container, add_feature then add_filling; consult buildingSMART spec.

gloss_en: Installing IfcOpenShell by copying folders to site-packages and listing IfcColumn names; bundled tools (IfcTester, IfcCsv, IfcDiff, IfcClash)
title_original: IfcOpenShellのインストール及び使い方
question_paraphrase: GitHubのZipを解凍しifcopenshell等をsite-packagesへコピー。by_type('IfcColumn')で柱名を一覧
phrasing_notes: Encourages reading errors, DeepL, ChatGPT then docs
answer_summary: Use python -m <package> -h for undocumented tools.

gloss_en: Beginner explanation of Open BIM, OpenCDE, IFC, BCF; converting to IFC does not guarantee identical results
title_original: Open BIM・OpenCDE・IFC・BCFとは？BIM初心者でも分かるデータ連携の基本
question_paraphrase: IFCにしても同じ結果になるとは限らない。BCFで梁とダクトの干渉を共有
phrasing_notes: Plain beginner register
answer_summary: openBIM = philosophy; IFC model exchange; BCF issues; OpenCDE API standards.

gloss_en: Reduce Revit file size by purging unused items; 222MB to 200MB
title_original: Revit｜ファイルを軽量化する方法
question_paraphrase: 管理タブの未使用の項目を削除を繰り返し、CAD読込・点群・ビューを先に削除
phrasing_notes: Menu-path walkthrough in Japanese UI terms
answer_summary: Purge repeatedly until 0; delete imports, point clouds, extra views first.

gloss_en: buildingSMART Japan IFC certification (IFC検定): software must conform to an MVD
title_original: IFC検定とは？
question_paraphrase: 検定対象ソフトはMVDに合致する必要。結果は管理台帳とサイトで公表
phrasing_notes: Official institutional prose
answer_summary: Aligns with international certification, feeds back to MVD; passing software list is on a separate page.

gloss_en: Count proxy elements and which Revit categories they came from
prompt: このIFC、IfcBuildingElementProxyが何個あるか数えて、元のRevitカテゴリ別に集計して。マッピング直す対象知りたい
expected_behavior: Count IfcBuildingElementProxy, group by ObjectType/Revit category property, report counts, suggest IfcExportAs mapping fixes.

gloss_en: For BIM drawing review check each IfcSpace has a name, usage and floor area
prompt: 確認申請用に出したIFCの全IfcSpaceについて、部屋名・用途・床面積が入ってるか確認して。抜けてる部屋は一覧で
expected_behavior: List IfcSpace, check Name/LongName, usage property and Qto_SpaceBaseQuantities NetFloorArea, report missing ones with GlobalId and storey.

gloss_en: Half of the elements are missing in the IFC; find out why
prompt: IFCに出したら半分くらい要素が無い…Revitの元モデルと比べて何が落ちてるか調べて。階に紐づいてないやつとか
expected_behavior: Compare element counts per category/class vs expectation, find elements not contained in any IfcBuildingStorey, report likely causes (visibility, level, category mapping).

gloss_en: Total concrete volume of walls, columns and beams by storey for estimating
prompt: 積算用に、階ごとのRC壁・柱・梁のコンクリ体積を合計して。Qtoが無いものは形状から出せる？
expected_behavior: Aggregate NetVolume from Qto per IfcWall/IfcColumn/IfcBeam by storey and material, flag elements missing Qto and say whether geometry-derived values are available.

gloss_en: Check against our IDS that every wall has FireRating and report failures
prompt: うちのIDSで納品IFCをチェックして。壁にFireRatingが入ってないものと、PredefinedType未設定のものを出して
expected_behavior: Run or emulate IDS facets (Entity IfcWall, Property Pset_WallCommon.FireRating, PredefinedType attribute), list failing elements.

gloss_en: Diff last week's IFC and today's: added, removed, changed elements
prompt: 先週のIFCと今日のIFC比べて、追加・削除・変更された部材をGlobalIdベースで出して。変更は属性か形状かも
expected_behavior: Match by GlobalId, report added/removed, compare attributes/properties and placement/geometry hash for modified.

gloss_en: List ducts per system and their storey
prompt: 設備IFCの空調ダクトをシステム名別・階別に本数と合計長さでまとめて
expected_behavior: Collect IfcDuctSegment, group by IfcSystem membership and containing storey, sum Length quantity, report ungrouped.

gloss_en: Find clashes between ducts and beams in the ceiling zone and create BCF issues
prompt: 天井内のダクトと梁の干渉探して、BCFにして出して。クリアランス50mmで
expected_behavior: Run clash with 50 mm tolerance between IfcDuctSegment and IfcBeam, produce BCF topics with viewpoints and GUIDs.

gloss_en: Add classification code to all doors by type name
prompt: ドアにタイプ名ごとに分類コード付けたい。D-1→21-21 11みたいな対応表あるからそれで一括で
expected_behavior: Create IfcClassification/IfcClassificationReference and assign to each IfcDoor by type mapping, report unmapped types.

gloss_en: Room area in IFC differs from the Revit schedule; check units and boundary
prompt: IFCの面積がRevitの集計表と合わない。単位か境界の問題？部屋ごとに差を出して
expected_behavior: Report project length unit and area unit, compare Qto NetFloorArea vs GrossFloorArea per space, list rooms with differences.

gloss_en: Export equipment list with maker, model number and install location to Excel
prompt: 維持管理用に、機器の名称・メーカー・型番・設置階と室をExcelに出して。空欄の項目も分かるように
expected_behavior: Query IfcDistributionElement/IfcFlowTerminal, read manufacturer/model properties, containing storey and space, write table, mark blanks.

gloss_en: List steel beam profiles and total weight
prompt: 鉄骨の梁をプロファイル別に本数と重量集計して。H-400x200とか
expected_behavior: List IfcBeam with IfcIShapeProfileDef, group by ProfileName, sum weight from quantities or computed, flag missing.

gloss_en: IFC opens in Revit but properties and parameters are missing
prompt: IFCをRevitで開くと属性が全然出てこない…リンクとか開くとか何が違う？
expected_behavior: Explain Open vs Link IFC, parameter mapping, IFC version/MVD, how to check Pset presence in file.

gloss_en: Beginner asks how to list wall names with IfcOpenShell
prompt: IfcOpenShellで壁の名前一覧出したいんだけどby_typeの書き方これで合ってる？
expected_behavior: Show ifc.by_type('IfcWall') and .Name loop, mention IfcWallStandardCase in IFC2x3.

gloss_en: Check fire-compartment related properties on walls and slabs for permit review
prompt: 防火区画に関係する壁と床の耐火時間が入っているか、IsExternalと一緒に確認して
expected_behavior: Collect IfcWall/IfcSlab, read FireRating and IsExternal from Pset common, report missing or inconsistent.

gloss_en: Model is 400MB; find what takes the space
prompt: 400MBのIFC重すぎ。エンティティ別にインスタンス数とサイズ内訳出して、何が原因か教えて
expected_behavior: Count instances per type, estimate size share (e.g. IfcFacetedBrep/IfcCartesianPoint), suggest reductions.

gloss_en: Find walls with no material assigned and list them by type
prompt: 材料が付いてない壁をタイプ別に出して。レイヤ構成も無いやつ
expected_behavior: For IfcWall check IfcRelAssociatesMaterial (IfcMaterialLayerSetUsage), list missing by type.
